qa_pairs.question: What is the page number and section title for this injection electronics diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: This is page 1364-6 from the INJECTION ELECTRONICS section for the S14 ENGINE.

qa_pairs.question: What wire color and gauge connects the diagnostic connector to the A/C compressor controls?
qa_pairs.answer: A .75 BK/RD wire connects the diagnostic connector to the A/C compressor controls.

qa_pairs.question: Which fuse protects the power distribution circuit shown in the upper right corner?
qa_pairs.answer: FUSE 9 (7.5 AMP) protects the power distribution circuit.

qa_pairs.question: What type of sensor is connected to pin 24 of the solid state module?
qa_pairs.answer: An oxygen sensor is connected to pin 24 of the solid state module.

qa_pairs.question: What wire gauge and color connects from the fuel pump relay referenced on page 1364-4?
qa_pairs.answer: A .5 YL/VI wire connects from the fuel pump relay referenced on page 1364-4.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two cylinder identification sensors shown at the bottom of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The two cylinder identification sensors shown are labeled as SHIELD components with 5 BK and 5 YL connections.

qa_pairs.question: What connector designation is used for the evaporative purge valve relay?
qa_pairs.answer: Connector C101 is used for the evaporative purge valve relay connections.

qa_pairs.question: What does the engine speed sensor connect to according to the flywheel teeth reference?
qa_pairs.answer: The engine speed sensor connects to sense flywheel teeth for engine speed detection.
